alt: JSON messages on the Kafka topic cocoindex-csv-rows are dispatched by shape: messages with a sku go to the LanceDB table products and messages with an emp_id go to employees; consuming live, a new SKU003 message updates its products row in place, and reading the table back returns rows with price as a float.
needs: Kafka broker (topic filled by the csv-to-kafka example)

run.note: Fill the topic first: run the csv-to-kafka example against the same broker
run.cmd: (cd ../csv_to_kafka && cp .env.example .env && pip install -e . && cocoindex update main.py)

run.note: Consume into LanceDB, then keep consuming
In another terminal, read the products table
